const patch="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Camera-guided drawer opening controller for the single live episode.
+
+Run one stage at a time; each invocation reconnects to the same episode.
+The waypoints are world-frame estimates from calibrated RGB-D cameras.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+
+sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path("/app/runs")
+
+
+def state(robot):
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=["topview", "left"], include_depth=True)
+    p = obs.meta["proprio"]
+    v = dict(zip(p["layout"], p["now"]))
+    return obs, v
+
+
+def save_and_report(result, name):
+    d = OUT / name
+    result.save(str(d))
+    p = result.meta["proprio"]
+    v = dict(zip(p["layout"], p["now"]))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        "stage": name,
+        "tcp": [v[f"tcp_{a}"] for a in "xyz"],
+        "mocap": [v[f"mocap_{a}"] for a in "xyz"],
+        "gripper_opening": v["gripper_opening"],
+        "control_steps": result.meta["control_steps"],
+        "time_left_s": result.meta.get("time_left_s"),
+        "done": result.meta["done"],
+    }, indent=2))
+
+
+def move_tcp(robot, target, grip, name, max_step_m=0.004, settle=20):
+    _, v = state(robot)
+    tcp = np.array([v[f"tcp_{a}"] for a in "xyz"], dtype=float)
+    mocap = np.array([v[f"mocap_{a}"] for a in "xyz"], dtype=float)
+    desired_mocap = np.array(target, dtype=float) + mocap - tcp
+    delta = desired_mocap - mocap
+    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(delta)) / max_step_m)))
+    action = np.r_[delta / (0.01 * n), grip]
+    actions = np.repeat(action[None, :], n, axis=0)
+    if settle:
+        actions = np.vstack([actions, np.tile([0, 0, 0, grip], (settle, 1))])
+    result = robot.submit("ee_delta", actions, dt=robot.spec()["control_dt"],
+                          cameras=["topview", "left", "right"], video="frames",
+                          include_depth=True, note=name)
+    save_and_report(result, name)
+
+
+def grip_hold(robot, grip, name, steps=30):
+    actions = np.tile([0, 0, 0, grip], (steps, 1))
+    result = robot.submit("ee_delta", actions, dt=robot.spec()["control_dt"],
+                          cameras=["topview", "left", "right"], video="frames",
+                          include_depth=True, note=name)
+    save_and_report(result, name)
+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument("stage", choices=["lift", "align", "pregrasp", "engage", "close", "pull", "inspect"])
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    robot = Robot()
+    if args.stage == "lift":
+        move_tcp(robot, [0.004, 0.601, 0.205], -1, "lift")
+    elif args.stage == "align":
+        move_tcp(robot, [-0.105, 0.685, 0.190], -1, "align")
+    elif args.stage == "pregrasp":
+        move_tcp(robot, [-0.105, 0.696, 0.105], -1, "pregrasp")
+    elif args.stage == "engage":
+        move_tcp(robot, [-0.105, 0.747, 0.105], -1, "engage")
+    elif args.stage == "close":
+        grip_hold(robot, 1, "close", steps=40)
+    elif args.stage == "pull":
+        move_tcp(robot, [-0.105, 0.535, 0.105], 1, "pull", max_step_m=0.0025, settle=30)
+    else:
+        obs, _ = state(robot)
+        save_and_report(obs, "inspect")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch))
